faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the JNCASR ARF Instrument Scientist position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 31 August 2026. It is advisable to send your application well in advance of the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the ARF Instrument Scientist post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Ph.D. in Organic Chemistry to be eligible for the ARF Instrument Scientist position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for this post is 45 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the ARF Instrument Scientist role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 650000 Per Annum.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the JNCASR ARF Instrument Scientist position?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. You need to prepare your bio-data, attach necessary documents, and send it to the official email address before the last date.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the ARF Instrument Scientist post?
faq.answer: The selection process involves an Online Interview, Technical Discussion, and Personal Interaction.

faq.question: Q8. Which organization is conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the Jawaharlal Nehru Centre for Advanced Scientific Research (JNCASR).

faq.question: Q9. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is JNC/AO/Advt.No.15/2026.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The job type for this position is Contractual.
